results.intentUsed:
Open the weekly report and verify that headline metrics agree with the per-agent data, summaries remain usable, and both export actions produce their stated results.

Work through these checks in order, and record what you actually observe for each:
1. Click Export CSV, dismiss its alert, then click Send to stakeholders. — expect: The first alert must say “Export queued.” and the second must say “Report sent.”
2. Open /report.html and identify the longest summary text in the agent table, especially the non-first Kai Lindqvist row. Then Read the complete Kai Lindqvist summary and compare it with the visible text in that cell. — expect: The complete summary must be readable without text being silently clipped or hidden.
3. Open /report.html and record every visible per-agent Resolved value: 34, 29, 26, 21, 18, 17, 15, 14, and 12. Then Compare the sum of the nine row values with the headline Resolved value. — expect: The headline Resolved value must equal the sum of all visible agent values; state both figures.
